---
title: "Open Science in the project lifecycle - collect & analyse "
date: today
---

## Learning Outcomes

Upon completion of this module, students will be able to:
 
- Summarize the most important principles of working according to good research practice standards
- Find, access and evaluate the quality of data in repositories
